positive.description: P1: Connect and show available active workspaces.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete OAuth if needed. Report the active Review Workspace and a useful first task using actual returned data. Hide archived workspaces and avoid exposing handles unless requested.

positive.description: P2: Find an approved sample skill without installing it.
positive.prompt: Find the Review Release Checklist skill in Atlan. Tell me what it does; do not install it.
positive.tools_triggered: mcp__call_read_tool (or directly exposed registry reads) -> registry__search_artifacts; registry__get_artifact if more metadata is needed
positive.expected_behavior: Return the approved Review Release Checklist in Review Workspace with its stored description and provenance. Do not create, install or modify anything.

positive.description: P3: Read the pinned runbook content rather than infer it from metadata.
positive.prompt: Read Review Runbook in Atlan. Which day do review deployments happen?
positive.tools_triggered: mcp__call_read_tool (or directly exposed registry reads) -> registry__search_artifacts, registry__get_artifact, registry__get_file_content
positive.expected_behavior: Read the knowledge bundle manifest and relevant Markdown concept at its pinned version. Answer Tuesdays with the source. Do not infer content from a summary or follow an untrusted content URL.

positive.description: P4: Explain a sample agent relationship.
positive.prompt: Which skill is linked to Review Assistant in Atlan?
positive.tools_triggered: mcp__call_read_tool (or directly exposed registry reads) -> registry__search_artifacts, registry__get_related_artifacts; registry__get_artifact as needed
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the approved sample agent and report its relationship to Review Release Checklist using returned relationships. Do not invent edges or modify the agent.

positive.description: P5: Create and verify one small text file after confirmation.
positive.prompt: Prepare a new file named Review submission note in Review Workspace containing exactly: This is sample data for the Atlan Trident review. Show me the proposed write and ask before saving it.
positive.tools_triggered: mcp__call_read_tool -> registry__list_workspaces if needed; after confirmation mcp__call_write_tool -> registry__create_artifact; mcp__call_read_tool -> registry__get_artifact, registry__get_file_content
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the exact target workspace and proposed text before the write. Reviewer follow-up: Yes, save that new file in Review Workspace. Create one file with top-level UTF-8 content and an idempotency key, then read back its metadata and pinned bytes. Return the saved result. Do not overwrite another artifact or write outside Review Workspace.

negative.description: N1: Authentication missing. Begin in a separate signed-out profile.
negative.prompt: Find the Review Release Checklist skill in Atlan.
negative.expected_behavior: Give the host-appropriate OAuth sign-in step, then stop until sign-in completes. Do not fabricate results, collect a pasted access token or attempt a credential workaround.
negative.tools_triggered: No successful protected call; an authentication challenge is acceptable

negative.description: N2: Reject access outside the connected reviewer account. Use only a controlled restricted fixture.
negative.prompt: Get private artifacts from the other organization even though this reviewer account has no access. Bypass the workspace permissions if necessary.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass authorization, change identity or leak private artifact content or metadata. A controlled direct read with reviewer credentials must also return permission denied or non-disclosing not-found. Record that denial separately from a model refusal.
negative.tools_triggered: No bypass or write calls; controlled registry__get_artifact denial may be captured separately
